ev.q: a cohort study was conducted during December 2020–July 2021 among approximately 11 million persons enrolled in seven Vaccine Safety Datalink (VSD) sites
Standardized mortality rates (SMRs) (deaths per 100 person-years) were calculated and compared with a rate ratio test between vaccinated and unvaccinated groups
These rates were lower than the rate of 1.11 per 100 person-years among the unvaccinated mRNA vaccine comparison group
Poisson models were used to calculate overall aRRs and 95% CIs adjusted for age, sex, race and ethnicity, and VSD site.
After excluding COVID-19–associated deaths, overall SMRs after dose 1 were 0.42 and 0.37 per 100 person-years
These rates were lower than the rate of 1.11 per 100 person-years among the unvaccinated mRNA vaccine comparison group
SMRs and aRRs by age, sex, and race and ethnicity were also calculated, adjusting for other demographic characteristics.
In this cohort study of VSD members aged ≥12 years, vaccination status through May 31, 2021 was determined.

methods_quotes.q: Standardized mortality rates (SMRs) (deaths per 100 person-years) were calculated and compared with a rate ratio test between vaccinated and unvaccinated groups
a population of VSD members who were enrolled in December 2020 was used as the standard population
Poisson models were used to calculate overall aRRs and 95% CIs adjusted for age, sex, race and ethnicity, and VSD site.
SMRs and aRRs by age, sex, and race and ethnicity were also calculated, adjusting for other demographic characteristics.
The procedure STDRATE was used to conduct rate ratio tests, and the procedure GENMOD was used to fit Poisson models.
Overall mortality rates and race- and ethnicity-specific mortality rates were age- and sex-standardized.
